reviewer: Codex; Jev integration unavailable and not used
decision_rule: Missing evidence yields insufficient-evidence, never inferred success.

items.question: Can a new remote user join with only an invitation?
items.missing_observation: The current invite requires reachable HTTP first; Tailcat member key registration already requires Wabi authentication.
items.existing_evidence_and_limits: docs/deployment/DESKTOP_HOSTING.md; F03 explicitly used management-assisted pre-enrollment.
items.smallest_next_change: Implement the separately planned expiring, invitation-only first-contact enrollment; preserve member transport authorization.
items.measurement_verification: Fresh profiles on independent networks; redeem, replay, expire, revoke, restart; no management bootstrap.
items.placement: product feature; larger than this campaign fix

items.question: Can the package run on all available Linux clients?
items.missing_observation: The Bazzite-built desktop and bundled libraries require glibc 2.43; Mint has 2.39.
items.smallest_next_change: Build against the oldest supported Linux runtime in a pinned builder, then package and install-test it on Mint and Bazzite.
items.measurement_verification: Run the actual AppImage on clean supported distributions; test native media dependencies as well as startup.

items.question: Does connected mean requests can reach the Authority?
items.missing_observation: IPC returns after a fixed delay and live-child check. Candidate A returned in ~507 ms; its first successful health request took ~2293 ms.
items.smallest_next_change: Report connecting until local proxy binding and a bounded application readiness probe succeed; retain a clear failure state.
items.measurement_verification: Inject delayed/failed tunnel startup and occupied ports; compare UI state with actual requests.

items.question: Do credentials and offline state survive changing proxy ports?
items.missing_observation: A reconnect picked a new loopback port. Transport recovered, but automatic native account continuity was not proved. Explicit Tailcat server key persistence also remains unfinished.
items.component: Native hosting identity + frontend server/account scope
items.smallest_next_change: Bind proxy connections to verified logical server identity; persist the intended per-community transport key without crossing account/server boundaries.
items.measurement_verification: Restart client and disposable Authority with new proxy ports; preserve correct account/offline state and reject an unrelated server.

items.question: Was the active Wabi tunnel direct or relayed?
items.missing_observation: The native status exposes only child/port state, not observed transport route. Existing management Tailscale status is not this route.
items.existing_evidence_and_limits: F03/F05 route observation is explicitly unknown.
items.smallest_next_change: Expose route events/counters from the active tunnel if the pinned CLI supports them; otherwise keep unknown visible.
items.measurement_verification: Correlate controlled direct/relay transitions with the same active connection; do not substitute a separate ping tunnel.

items.question: Did a helper carry media, and did the Authority benefit?
items.missing_observation: No eligible isolated publicly reachable SFU was available. Heartbeats/domain health cannot answer workload placement.
items.smallest_next_change: Record assigned node, backend room/session, selected endpoint, actual participant tracks and scoped traffic, then run matched helper-off/on calls.
items.measurement_verification: Correlate Authority assignment with SFU room/track counters and both clients; repeat equal workloads.
items.placement: product diagnostics and future controlled field run

items.question: What did every participant actually hear/see?
items.missing_observation: No human physical-media run. GPU activity, codecs, frames, jitter/loss, playback interruptions and per-stream routing unavailable here. Socket echo timing is signaling RTT.
items.existing_evidence_and_limits: Physical scenarios NOT TESTED; callingDiagnostics.ts and CallDebugPanel.svelte source review.
items.smallest_next_change: Export requested/observed backend per media type and source-tagged per-participant stats; label signaling RTT separately. Add opt-in audio queue/underrun counters where supported.
items.measurement_verification: Known synthetic impairment + human heard/seen checks on each participant; distinguish unsupported/stale/unavailable from zero.

items.question: How much traffic and resource use belongs to Wabi?
items.missing_observation: Process CPU/RSS/IO available; interface traffic is host-wide. Child-tree RSS can double-count shared pages. FUSE/compositor/harness are outside the sampled client tree.
items.existing_evidence_and_limits: Raw JSONL exports and resource-summary.json; collector wall overhead recorded.
items.smallest_next_change: Temporary collector implemented. Add app-attributed socket/cgroup counters only when available and necessary; retain current scope labels.
items.measurement_verification: Synthetic child CPU/lifetime validation passed; compare against OS counters with an isolated known transfer.

items.question: Was the native UI visually correct on Iyoku?
items.missing_observation: Native IPC/DOM actions work, but WebKit snapshot capture times out and X11 capture cannot read the window. Client CPU differs sharply from the coordinator; rendering conditions are not comparable.
items.smallest_next_change: Obtain a visible native-window capture or human confirmation before visual/media acceptance; do not infer painted output from DOM checks.
items.measurement_verification: Verify readable actual pixels on the intended desktop, then rerun any rendering comparison.

items.question: Do REST-created messages notify open chat clients?
items.missing_observation: REST messages persist and are retrievable, but were not delivered live in F05; normal Socket.IO message events are tested separately.
items.existing_evidence_and_limits: F05-fixed-Tailcat-rest-gap.json; api/messages.rs emits only specialized Steam-link notifications; socketio/messages.rs owns normal message broadcast.
items.smallest_next_change: Decide/document the REST realtime contract; if live notification is intended, emit the canonical committed message event without duplicating Socket.IO delivery.
items.measurement_verification: An already joined client receives one REST-created message, with stable ID and authorized scope, after durable acceptance; no duplicate on refresh.
items.placement: separate focused behavioral follow-up; normal native chat path is usable
